title: Santa Rosa Island Fire — 17,554ac 44% 진압, 야간 활동 현저 감소 ★업데이트
snippet: As of May 21, 2026, the Santa Rosa Island Fire has burned 17,554 acres and is at 44% containment. Overnight fire activity significantly lower — mostly low-intensity ground fire and smoldering. No new heat detected. Humidity soared. Scoopers dropped 100,800 gallons of sea water in 2 days. Largest ever recorded fire on Channel Islands.
tag_reason: 진압률 26%→44%로 유의미한 진전. 야간 활동 현저 감소 — 새로운 상태 정보.
